bull.b: Strong revenue and active-buyer growth indicate expanding marketplace engagement and improving demand. A larger buyer base can support repeat transactions, better marketplace liquidity, and more efficient customer acquisition over the next several quarters.

bull.t: High gross margin and EBITDA improvement
bull.b: The combination of approximately 80% gross margin and positive adjusted EBITDA shows meaningful operating leverage in the platform model. Continued efficiency and logistics improvements could help convert revenue growth into stronger underlying profitability.

Positive operating cash flow despite GAAP losses suggests working-capital and operating discipline have improved. If sustained, cash generation can reduce dependence on external funding and provide resources for technology, marketing, and marketplace expansion.

bear.b: The company has not yet reached sustainable GAAP profitability, and the latest quarterly loss increased year over year. Continued losses can erode equity, constrain financial flexibility, and make durable earnings conversion dependent on further scale and cost improvements.

Reliance on elevated promotions is pressuring revenue and average selling prices while management works to support conversion. This can weaken monetization and margins if price-sensitive demand persists, making near-term growth less profitable and less predictable.

bear.t: Thin and volatile free cash flow
bear.b: Although operating cash flow is positive, thin free cash flow leaves limited room for execution setbacks, investment needs, or renewed losses. Its decline from the prior annual period also indicates that cash conversion is not yet consistently durable.
